drafts.subject: Notice: General Body Meeting on rooftop solar (Sunrise Apartments)
drafts.body:
Dear members,

A general body meeting of Sunrise Apartments will be held on [to be set by committee].

Agenda: approve a 36 kW rooftop solar system for common facilities.
Estimated net cost to the society after subsidy: Rs 1,152,000 (subsidy Rs 648,000). Estimated simple payback: about 3.3 years.
These are estimates from the committee's analysis tool and will be confirmed with vendor quotes and the DISCOM.

Secretary

drafts.subject: Draft resolution
drafts.body: RESOLVED that Sunrise Apartments approves, in principle, installation of a 36 kW rooftop solar plant for common facilities, with costs and savings shared on the 'equal' basis, subject to DISCOM approval and a verified installer. The committee is authorised to apply on the national portal and to sign only after required approvals.
